Battery arbitrage controller for ComEd real-time pricing with EP Cube and WeMo-controlled battery systems. Manages two physically separate batteries (EP Cube 20 kWh via cloud API, WeMo-controlled battery via smart plugs), making charge/discharge/hold decisions every 3 minutes based on real-time electricity prices and solar production.
